# benchmark-accessibility-fix

> Repair a broken HTML page so keyboard, screen-reader, and contrast checks pass.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-accessibility-fix
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-accessibility-fix
Directory: https://aibenchmarkindex.com/benchmarks/benchmark-accessibility-fix

## What it measures

Each of the 40 tasks ships a small HTML page with two to four seeded
defects (missing alt text, unlabeled inputs, low contrast, heading order,
positive tabindex, div-as-button, missing lang, no focus style, empty
link, table without headers). The model returns the fixed document. The
deterministic grader in `src/a11y.ts` checks the repair and penalizes
regressions, deleted text, removed elements, and hidden content.

## Exports

The root exports `benchmark`, `run`, and `score`. `benchmark-accessibility-fix/api` exports the fetch-style `handler`. `benchmark-accessibility-fix/mcp` exports MCP builders.

## Commands

The CLI supports list, show, run, score, card, provenance, index-entry, serve, and mcp. Use the mock provider for offline verification.

## Data and grading

Tasks come from `scripts/gen-tasks.mjs --seed 20261015` (see
`data/PROVENANCE.md`). Grading rules and failure modes live in
`docs/grading.md`. Regenerate tasks with `npm run generate:tasks`.

## Verification

Run `npm run ci:local`. The report is `artifacts/e2e-report.json`. The
E2E scores every reference fix (each must reach 1) and four trivial
answers per task (each must score 0).
